_comment: Merge the object below into the `settings` array in the Artera theme's manifest.json.
It appears as its own group in Guide > Customize design, so the content team can
edit subheaders and resource-card copy without a theme deploy.
Zendesk supports these variable types: text, checkbox, range, list, color, file.
There is no multi-line type — keep copy to one line.
label: Descriptors & subheaders

variables.label: Show category descriptions
variables.description: Print the description from Guide > Arrange content under each category card.

variables.label: Show section descriptions
variables.description: Print the section description as a subheader on category pages.

variables.label: Show article snippets
variables.description: Print the first ~100 characters of each article under its title in article lists.
